Class CountryRenderer

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.render.CountryRenderer
public class CountryRenderer extends Object
Renders a collection of GeoJsonCountryLoader.CountryFeature instances onto an IContainer using a supplied IMapProjection and its associated MapTheme.

Rendering pipeline

  1. Iterate over all country features.
  2. For each polygon ring, split it at any antimeridian crossing (detected via IMapProjection.crossesSeam(double, double)) into at most two WorldPolygon objects in world (projection-space) coordinates.
  3. Draw each polygon via WorldGraphicsUtils.drawWorldPolygon(Graphics2D, IContainer, WorldPolygon, Color, Color, float), which converts world coordinates to screen space using the container's transform.
  4. Cache the resulting polygons for later hit-testing by pickCountry(Point, IContainer).

Seam splitting

Cylindrical projections (Mercator, Mollweide) have a seam at the edge of the map. Polygon edges that cross the seam would otherwise be drawn as a long horizontal line across the entire map. The renderer detects such crossings via IMapProjection.crossesSeam(double, double) and routes subsequent points into an "other side" polygon so each half renders correctly.

Hit-testing and cache dependency

pickCountry(Point, IContainer) uses a cache of WorldPolygon objects that is built during render(Graphics2D, IContainer). This means pickCountry must be called after the first render(Graphics2D, IContainer) call, and will return null for all countries if called before any render. In practice this is safe because a mouse-over event cannot occur before the first paint, but callers should be aware of the dependency. The cache is fully rebuilt on every render call so it always reflects the most recent projection state.

Border stroke

The border color and stroke are taken from the theme via MapTheme.getBorderColor() and MapTheme.getBorderStroke(). These are passed through to WorldGraphicsUtils.drawWorldPolygon(Graphics2D, IContainer, WorldPolygon, Color, Color, float) so that theme switching is fully respected.

  • Constructor Details

    • CountryRenderer

      public CountryRenderer(List<GeoJsonCountryLoader.CountryFeature> countryFeatures, IMapProjection projection)
      Creates a renderer for the given country features and projection.

      The theme is obtained from projection.getTheme() at render time, so theme changes applied to the projection are reflected automatically without reconstructing the renderer.

      Parameters:
      countryFeatures - list of country features to render; must not be null
      projection - the map projection; must not be null

    • pickCountry

      public GeoJsonCountryLoader.CountryFeature pickCountry(Point mouseLocal, IContainer container)
      Returns the first country whose projected polygon contains the given mouse position, or null if no country is hit.

      Requires a prior render call. The hit-test uses the WorldPolygon cache that is built during render(Graphics2D, IContainer). If render has not been called yet (or has been called on a different IContainer), this method will always return null.

      Parameters:
      mouseLocal - mouse position in the container's local coordinate space; must not be null
      container - container providing the local-to-world transform; must not be null
      Returns:
      the hit country, or null

    • copyStyleFrom

      public void copyStyleFrom(CountryRenderer source)
      Copies user-configurable rendering properties from another country renderer.

      Geographic data, projection state, and the projected polygon cache are deliberately not copied.

      Parameters:
      source - renderer whose style settings should be copied
